actions.name: sent spearphishing email inviting to non-existent conference with QR code leading to fake Google login page
actions.description: In June 2025, Kimsuky actors sent a strategic advisory firm a spearphishing email inviting recipients to a non-existent conference. The email contained a QR code that directed the user to a registration landing page with a button to register. The registration button took visitors to a fake Google account login page, where users could input their login credentials for harvesting.
